title: Daily 5, Sun 22 Nov
sourceNote: Original questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 5 questions, 10 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Everyone gets the same five. The ranking is by marks, then by time.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, rupee sign or units.

questions.text: If α and β are the roots of x² − 7x + 10 = 0, what is α² + β²?
The price of an item is cut by 20% and then by a further 10%. What is the net cut?
The average of 4 numbers is 25. One of them, 10, is replaced by 30. What is the new average?
Find the difference between CI (compounded annually) and SI on ₹6,000 for 2 years at 10% per annum.
A is twice as efficient as B. Together they finish a job in 12 days. How many days would A take alone?
